survey: A witch hat floating on an orange background, seen from slightly above and to the front. Main parts: (1) The brim is a wide, flat, rounded disc. It looks oval only because of the viewing angle, and its rolled edge has even thickness all the way around. (2) The cone rises from roughly the centre of the brim, narrows smoothly and curls slightly back and to the right at the tip. That curl is normal for a witch hat. (3) A purple band wraps around the base of the cone where it meets the brim. It follows the cone's circular shape, sits flush on the brim and stays the same height all the way round. (4) A gold square buckle faces the camera at the front of the band. It has a rectangular frame with a double centre bar, a simplified version of a real buckle. The hat has no surface to rest on, but it is a card icon on an abstract background, so floating is fine. The cone and brim join cleanly, without melting into each other or passing through each other. The band neither floats nor cuts into the brim.
